age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 60 years for all posts. | Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

qualification.education_qualification: MD/ DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Diploma/ Certificate in Health Inspector
qualification.details: Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics): MD (Doctor of Medicine) / DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute / Hospital / Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. A minimum experience of 01(One) year working with Government Hospital / Organizations / reputed and recognised Private Hospital is mandatory. Visiting Medical Consultant (Paediatrician): MD (Doctor of Medicine) / DNB in Paediatrics (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute / Hospital / Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. A minimum experience of 01(One) year working with Government Hospital / Organizations / reputed and recognised Private Hospital is mandatory. Visiting Health Inspector: Diploma/ Certificate in Health Inspector/ Sanitary Inspector/ Public Health from a recognized institution. A minimum experience of 5 years in health inspection, sanitation, hygiene and public-health activities, particularly in educational institutions, hostels, hospitals or large residential establishments is mandatory.

salary_details.details: Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics): Rs. 12,000/ - per visit of 2 hours Visiting Medical Consultant (Paediatrician): Rs. 12,000/ - per visit of 2 hours Visiting Health Inspector: Rs. 3,000/ - per visit of 2 hours

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGNAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGNAU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics), 1 for Visiting Medical Consultant (Paediatrician) and 1 for Visiting Health Inspector.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics): MD (Doctor of Medicine) / DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute / Hospital / Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. A minimum experience of 01(One) year working with Government Hospital / Organizations / reputed and recognised Private Hospital is mandatory. Visiting Medical Consultant (Paediatrician): MD (Doctor of Medicine) / DNB in Paediatrics (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute / Hospital / Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. A minimum experience of 01(One) year working with Government Hospital / Organizations / reputed and recognised Private Hospital is mandatory. Visiting Health Inspector: Diploma/ Certificate in Health Inspector/ Sanitary Inspector/ Public Health from a recognized institution. A minimum experience of 5 years in health inspection, sanitation, hygiene and public-health activities, particularly in educational institutions, hostels, hospitals or large residential establishments is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 60 years for all posts. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics): Rs. 12,000/ - per visit of 2 hours Visiting Medical Consultant (Paediatrician): Rs. 12,000/ - per visit of 2 hours Visiting Health Inspector: Rs. 3,000/ - per visit of 2 hours

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGNAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGNAU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the RGNAU Recruitment 2026 is November 6, 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of Visiting Medical Consultant and Visiting Health Inspector.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Visiting Medical Consultant posts?
faq.answer: For Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics) and (Paediatrician), candidates need an MD/DNB in the respective specialization with at least one year of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Visiting Health Inspector post?
faq.answer: The Visiting Health Inspector will receive a salary of Rs. 3,000/- per visit, with each visit lasting approximately 2 hours.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the RGNAU Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts advertised under RGNAU Recruitment 2026 is 60 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Visiting Medical Consultant and Visiting Health Inspector positions at RGNAU will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University located?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University is located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual positions at Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of RGNAU or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.
